title: wg: protocol-06 §5.2 keyMaterial signature suite and select arm
description: Suggestion/erratum. (1) KeyMaterialRequest carries acceptableCiphersuites<V> but no cipher_suite, so the signature scheme for key_material_request_signature is unspecified (mimid requires suite 1, mimid-1wgh.5.61). (2) ClientKeyMaterial's select (clientStatus) has no arm for keyMaterialExhausted (mimid reads: no fields, mimid-1wgh.5.64). (3) 'non-empty list' for acceptableCiphersuites is prose only (mimid-1wgh.5.62). Fix: add a cipher_suite field or state the rule; add the missing arm; use <1..V> or state the minimum.
